_template: Parent-hub command-metadata.json scaffold. The file is a class-H requirement: one entry per slash command the hub owns, or the literal empty array [] when it owns none. Replace every [bracketed] placeholder and delete this wrapper object — the committed file's top level is the ARRAY below, not this object. Core fields shown are all required; hubs may add extension fields after them (the design hub adds register policies and task projections, for example) and the fleet gate ignores unknown fields.
